notes.title: Bug Fixes Update 2.0.3
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that caused issues after player death.
 Fixed the cat screamer event to work correctly without glitches.

notes.title: 🎮 Release 2.0: Major Update
notes.notes:
✋ Hands Added: Characters now display hands in-game.

 🤖 AI Completely Redesigned: Improved behavior.

 🏆 Achievements Added

 🕴 Slenderman Updated: Redesigned visuals and animations.

 📱 Phone Removed: Phone mechanic removed.

 🔦 Flashlight Added: Illuminates dark areas.

 🗺 Manual Map Added

 🐞 Bugs Fixed: Increased stability.

 ⚙ Map Optimization

 🛠 Settings Updated

 🎨 Post-Processing: Visual enhancements.

 💀 New Deaths: Different death scenarios.


Found a bug? Report it on Discord: https://discord.gg/PH625kue4t

notes.title: 📢 Update 1.0.3 is live!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the release of Version 1.0.3 with new features and improvements:

🛠 What’s New?

🌟 FOV Adjustment: Customize your Field of View for a more comfortable experience!
⚙️ Max FPS Setting: Set a cap for your frame rate to optimize performance.
🚀 Minor Optimizations: Improved overall game stability and performance.
🕵️ Slenderman Behavior Fixes: Adjustments to improve gameplay dynamics.


📩 Found a bug?
Let us know on our Discord server! Your feedback helps us make the game even better.

Thank you for your support! 💜
